longLivedAssets.label: Long-lived assets

notes: Oracle publishes no state or country economic-impact report that was found, and its FY2024 10-K gives no property or headcount breakdown by state or country beyond the U.S./international employee split and Note 14's long-lived assets by country (U.S., UK, Germany, Japan, other) (58,000 U.S., 101,000 international of ~159,000). Item 2 gives only the owned Austin HQ (~0.9M sq ft), ~27.7M sq ft of other facilities "in various other locations in the U.S. and abroad", the leased Hillsboro, Oregon hardware plant, and says cloud data centers are substantially all leased through colocation suppliers (no locations listed). Oracle's public cloud region list exists on oracle.com but is a list of locations with no figures and was not recorded. The "Outside the U.S." employee region and the "Other countries" long-lived-asset region are different groupings (the latter excludes UK, Germany and Japan).
